ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the surface is predominantly comprised of low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to less than 1% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across the entirety of both visible lobes; two distinct, high-contrast white circular blobs are located in the medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central notch with a shallow vertex angle dividing the symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed as a jagged linear boundary along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edges, transitioning to a sharper upward curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct, roughly circular white pixel clusters (high-contrast) detected on the mid-section of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of textured brown and tan biological growth (likely barnacles) are localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of the fluke exhibit significant geometric irregularity and bulbous texture due to extensive barnacle colonization.
